abilities.name: Permanent Cloak
abilities.description: Gain Stealth when out of combat for 3 seconds. Taking damage, attacking, using Abilities, or Channeling ends Stealth. Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds grants Invisible. Passive Gain 15% Movement Speed while Stealthed.; 3; trait

fields.notes: Stealth can activate while Mounted, but Mounting will break Stealth momentarily.

abilities.name: Snipe
abilities.description: Deals 230 damage to the first enemy hit. passive Hitting an enemy Hero with Snipe permanently increases the damage of Snipe by 6%, stacking up to 30%. Gain an additional 25% damage bonus at maximum stacks. All stacks are lost if Snipe fails to hit an enemy.

fields.notes: Damage bonus stacks additively with itself and offensive damage modifiers that can affect Snipe 's damage.

abilities.name: Pinning Shot
abilities.description: Deal 100 damage to an enemy and Slow them by 40% for 2.25 seconds.

abilities.name: Holo Decoy
abilities.description: Create a Decoy for 5 seconds with 100% of Nova's current Health that attacks enemies, dealing 10% of Nova's base damage. Whenever a Decoy takes damage it deals that amount to itself, effectively doubling the damage it takes. Using this Ability does not break Stealth. Holo Decoy

fields.notes: Decoy can use Snipe and Pinning Shot with reduced damage and Slow values. Decoys only use their Abilities against Heroes. If Nova is Stealthed while casting Holo Decoy, the decoy will also be Stealthed and vice versa. Stealthed Decoys only attack Heroes. Unstealthed decoys also attack Structures, Summons and aggroed Mercenaries, but not Minions, unless the Lethal Decoy Talent has been picked. Decoys will immediately attack the closest visible enemy Hero when one comes in its range and mimics Nova's Basic Abilities in the following order: Pinning Shot > Snipe > Basic Attack. Killing a Decoy grants no XP or Takedown credit. Decoy benefits from all of Nova's non-active Talents, unless otherwise noted. Decoy has its own base damage values, causing the damage reduction percentage to stack multiplicatively with offensive damage modifiers, but displays the floating damage text as if it were from the real Nova (full damage value).

abilities.name: Triple Tap
abilities.description: Locks in on the target Hero, then fires 3 shots that hit the first Hero or Structure they come in contact with for 372 damage each.; 100; 100; heroic

fields.props: Channeled cast (stationary), Revealed, Skillshot, Stationary channel
fields.notes: Triple Tap can hit Structures in their way but is only castable on Heroes. Nova can't take any actions while channeling Triple Tap. Triple Tap can't be manually canceled and only ends if its channeling is interrupted or if the target is killed, becomes untargetable, moves more than 50 units past its maximum range or once all 3 shots have been fired. Interrupting the channel in any way before any shots have been fired puts Triple Tap on a 10 second cooldown, and otherwise on full cooldown. The target is Revealed for the duration of the Ability and for 0.3 seconds afterward. Exceptionally, this Reveal persists through Unrevealable Stealth.

abilities.name: Precision Strike
abilities.description: After a 1.5 second delay, deals 435 damage to enemies within an area. Unlimited range.; 50; 100; heroic

fields.notes: Grants vision over the area for 6 seconds when the Ability starts casting. At the moment of impact, vision radius is increased by 1 for 1 second.

abilities.name: Ghost Protocol
abilities.description: Activate to instantly grant Stealth to Nova and spawn a Holo Decoy at her location. Nova is Unrevealable for the first 0.5 seconds when Stealthed by Ghost Protocol.

fields.notes: The decoy has the same properties as those created by Holo Decoy.

talents.name: Covert Mission
talents.description: Active Enemy Minions killed near Nova grant a stack of Bribe. Hero Takedowns grant 10 stacks of Bribe. Use 25 stacks to bribe a Mercenary, instantly defeating them. Does not work on Elite Mercenaries. Maximum of 100 stacks. If a camp is defeated entirely with Bribe, it respawns 50% faster.

fields.notes: Minions generate a stack, if they die within 12 radius of Nova or are dealt a killing blow by her Abilities or Basic Attacks. Decoys can collect stacks, if they dealt the finishing blow to the enemy, but not through presence.

Does not work on Elite Mercenaries. Maximum of 100 stacks. If a camp is defeated entirely with Bribe, it respawns 50% faster.

talents.name: Anti-Armor Shells
talents.description: Nova's Basic Attacks deal 250% damage and decrease the Physical Armor of Heroic targets by 15 for 4 seconds, but her Attack Speed is proportionally slower.

fields.notes: Increases Nova's Base Attack damage, causing the damage bonus to stack multiplicatively with offensive damage modifiers. Decoy's attacks also have modified base damage and base Attack Speed values, but do not apply the Armor reduction. Does not stack with itself or other negative Physical Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack. If and only if Nova's Basic Attack is off cooldown, causes the damage text for Decoy Basic Attacks to differ (exposing the real, lowered value).
